svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1396 commits across five public projects, 76 active days, peak 207 commits per day. 2026-07-21 through 2026-10-12 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-10-12T02:29:55.565Z.
